title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: Schedule of Start-Up Charges, Reservation Holds and Rent Discounts
content:
## Schedule A: charges and discounts at the start of a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement

The figures below are fixed per space class of the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement. The administrative fee is a one-time charge made when the parking agreement starts. The reservation hold is the number of calendar days a reservation holds the space after the reservation date. The move-in discount is a discount on the first billing period's rent, expressed as a share of the monthly rent. The military discount is a standing discount on every period's rent where the military discount is applied to the agreement.

| Space class | Administrative fee | Reservation hold | Move-in discount on first period | Military discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | $29.00 | 7 calendar days | 50% | 10% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $29.00 | 7 calendar days | 50% | 10% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $29.00 | 7 calendar days | 50% | 10% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $29.00 | 7 calendar days | 25% | 10% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $29.00 | 7 calendar days | 25% | 10% |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | $39.00 | 10 calendar days | 0% (no move-in discount) | 10% |

## Schedule B: entry requirements by space class

A space of each class is let only to a tenant who meets that class's entry requirements: a minimum age of 18 years, a current registration for the vehicle in the tenant's name, current liability insurance on the vehicle, and a vehicle no longer than the class's maximum length.

| Space class | Minimum age | Current registration in tenant's name | Current liability insurance | Maximum vehicle length |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 18 | Required | Required | 20 ft |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 18 | Required | Required | 30 ft |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 18 | Required | Required | 45 ft |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 18 | Required | Required | 30 ft |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 18 | Required | Required | 45 ft |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 18 | Required | Required | 40 ft |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- The administrative fee is the same $29.00 for every uncovered and covered class; only the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage carries $39.00.
- The Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage is the one class whose reservation hold runs 10 calendar days and the one class with no move-in discount.
- The military discount is 10% in every class; it is a figure of the class, and it reduces rent only on agreements where the military discount is applied.
